messages:
maria: FYI CVE-2026-1432 in grpc-core (handshake buffer overflow). Scanner flagged our internal grpc-core v1.43.0
aj: Priority P1? does it allow remote unauth'd RCE or just DoS?
security-bot: CVE-2026-1432 — grpc-core <1.43.2 — buffer overflow in handshake — CVSS 8.1 — exploitability: public PoC
maria: PoC exists, exploit requires crafted handshake. Recommend patch to 1.43.2. Need rollout plan + post-patch smoke + perf check.
kevin: Agreed. Plan: non-prod -> canary1 (10% dedicated pool) -> canary2 (50%) -> full. Canary windows 30m each. Will tag images as grpc-patch-176765
samir: I'll run smoke tests and throughput bench. Quick smoke script:
```
# smoke: basic rpc
grpcurl -d '{"q":"ping"}' -plaintext localhost:50051 example.Service/Health
```
samir: Also run rps perf harness: ./bench --concurrency 64 --duration 5m
elaine: Add latency SLAs: p95 <80ms, p99 <200ms. If p99 increases >10% rollback. Also run KV cache hit-rate check and embedding pipeline smoke.
aj: Need to ensure RBAC for canary: svc-account for canary gets limited KMS decrypts. Who owns KMS perms?
kevin: I'll create kms-grpc-canary role with minimal decrypt and audit logging enabled. We'll rotate keys if any plaintext exposure suspected. @maria do you want KMS audit log retained 90d?
maria: Yes 90d. Also enable structured audit logs for handshake failures.
security-bot: Marking patch ticket INFSEC-723 as in-progress. Adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/grpc-core-cve
samir: Ran smoke on canary1, all health checks green, basic bench looks +3% p95, p99 +8% — within threshold. Logs: 0 handshake errors.
kevin: deploy-bot: canary rollout started -> canary1 (10%) image grpc-patch-176765 deployed by @kevin :rocket:
maria: Start extended monitoring: prometheus queries to watch:
```
# p99 latency
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
# handshake error rate
sum(rate(grpc_handshake_errors_total[5m]))
```
elaine: I'll run model-serving smoke with sampling then run tracing to ensure no increased tail for generation.
aj: If any signing or KMS errors show up, pause rollout. Otherwise proceed to canary2 in 30m.
samir: no errors so far, metrics stable. I'll keep running bench for another 20m.
maria: Thanks everyone. If we see >10% reg in p99 or >0.1% handshake error, rollback and open incident. Otherwise proceed to full rollout after canary2 :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary1 -> ok. scheduled canary2 at 1767654700.
